# Honora Hollis

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen at her introduction (Volume 1), around nineteen or twenty by Volume 3.  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Single (unmarried)  <sub>[v3 c4 P10](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0010), [v3 c4 P22](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0022)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; former schoolteacher.  <sub>[v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Honora  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027)</sub>; Nonie  <sub>[v2 c29 P6](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0006), [v3 c4 P7](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nonie  <sub>[v2 c29 P6](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0006), [v3 c4 P7](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0007)</sub>; Dream girl  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Honora is described as a tall, fair, and ethereal-looking young woman. She has pale, light-colored hair and an appearance that gives the impression of someone who understands dreams, though she stands notably taller than most of her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v3 c4 P8](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0008), [v3 c4 P23](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0023)_

## Personality

Despite her pale, dream-like exterior, Honora is thoroughly packed with mischief, jokes, and humor. She possesses a clever, observant mind, excels at classical studies, and is deeply loyal to her close friends. While she appreciates poetry and quiet moments in nature, she also enjoys witty banter, teasing her companions, and sharing humorous observations about people and situations.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v3 c4 P22](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0022), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c6 P8](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0008)_

- Witty and mischievous  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v3 c6 P8](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0008)</sub>
- Poetic and appreciative of beauty  <sub>[v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v3 c4 P16](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0016)</sub>

- Excels at classical studies (Latin and Greek)  <sub>[v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- Pursue higher education and earn a University degree at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v2 c30 P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)</sub>
- Achieve high honors in Classics at Wexcombe  <sub>[v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>

## History

Honora Hollis first met Nell Harcourt while studying at Regent's Academy, where the two became close friends along with Mabel Colby. After completing her initial studies, Honora taught school in Delford for a time while preparing to advance her education. In her second year after Regent's, she enrolled at Wexcombe College, where she and Nell decided to room together. Along with Mabel and Cressida Lindsay, the girls leased and established a joint household at 'Tabby's Place' on Linden Avenue, managed by Mabel's Aunt Euphemia. Honora excelled in her studies at Wexcombe, specializing in the Classics and participating actively in college society, the Philomathic Society, and the Brierley Village Improvement Society. After three years of hard work, she successfully graduated with Honors in Classics.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v2 c6 P7](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0007), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020), [v3 c4 P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 c5 P1](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0001), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_

## Background by volume

- Attended Regent's Academy and studied alongside Nell Harcourt and Mabel Colby  <sub>[v1 c25 P6](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0006), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020)</sub>

> I believe that if it were possible to see a kiss, its appearance would resemble a violet.  <sub>[v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011)</sub>
